title: Training Note: Balance Merge Settings Across Cartwise Gift Cards
content:
**Which Cartwise Gift Cards card types can have their balance merged onto a Reloadable card?**
Three card types: the Cartwise eGift Card, the Cartwise Plastic Gift Card and the Cartwise Corporate Gift Card. The balance merge setting means the balance of the card can be moved onto a Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card of the same holder.

| Card type | Balance can be merged onto a Reloadable card of the same holder | Smallest balance that can be merged | Bonus value moves in a merge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | Yes | 1.00 | No |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | Yes | 1.00 | No |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | No | 0.00 | No |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | No | 0.00 | No |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | Yes | 1.00 | No |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | No | 0.00 | No |

Amounts are in US dollars.

**What is the smallest balance that can be merged?**
1.00 US dollar on each of the three card types that allow a merge. On the three card types that do not allow a merge the figure is 0.00, since no merge takes place from them.

**Does bonus value ever move in a merge?**
No. The setting is No on every card type.

**Can a Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card or a Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card be merged onto another card?**
No. Neither card type allows its balance to be merged.

### Hypothetical balances (illustrative inputs only)

| Sending card (hypothetical) | Balance | Meets the smallest mergeable balance? |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | 0.99 | No — below 1.00 |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | 1.00 | Yes — equal to 1.00 |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | 42.50 | Yes |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | 42.50 | Not applicable — the card type does not allow a merge |
